headline: Executive order on protecting presidential privileges and making federal contracting more efficient; few details are available.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with two topics: protecting the President's legal privileges, and changing how the federal government handles contracts with outside companies. No summary or text was provided, so the specific rules, requirements, or changes it makes are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.group: Companies and organizations that hold or seek federal government contracts
who_it_affects.how: The order's title says it aims to change federal contracting, which could affect how these businesses work with the government.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that buy goods and services
who_it_affects.how: Agencies may need to change how they manage contracts, though the exact changes are not described.
